# APThermo

APThermo computes the chemical equilibrium composition and thermodynamic properties of rocket propellant combustion products (Gibbs-energy minimization, Gordon–McBride), and from them the performance of a rocket engine: chamber, throat and nozzle-exit states under shifting-equilibrium or frozen flow. It runs on CPU and, for large batches, on an NVIDIA GPU (CUDA) in double precision. The NASA thermodynamic database is embedded; no data files are needed on disk.

## Guide
- [Rocket solving](docs/guide/rocket.md)
- [Batch solving](docs/guide/batch.md)
- [Equilibrium states](docs/guide/equilibrium.md)
- [States records](docs/guide/states.md)
- [Command line](docs/guide/cli.md)

## Schemas
- `apthermo schema input` — problem document shape
- `apthermo schema output` — result document shape
- `apthermo schema states` — state record shape
- `apthermo schema species` — species listing shape
- `apthermo schema devices` — device listing shape
